title: The effect of EU-funded enterprise support on firms and workers
title_hu: Az EU-forrásokból finanszírozott vállalati támogatások hatása a vállalatokra és dolgozóikra
summary_en: Hungary disbursed substantial EU enterprise-support funds (EFRE, ESF, Hungarian-managed grants) to firms over the 2007–2020 programming periods. Muraközy and Telegdy use Hungarian linked employer–employee administrative data to estimate the causal effect of EU-funded enterprise grants on recipient firms' employment, wages, and productivity, and on their workers' subsequent labour-market trajectories. The chapter quantifies the per-euro labour-market impact of EU enterprise-support spending.
policy_relevance: Direct input for Hungarian EU-funds programming (Miniszterelnökség EU Funds department, ITM, MFB) and for the design of post-2027 EU enterprise support. Provides the cleanest available Hungarian estimate of EU-grant labour-market effects, which should anchor the cost-benefit analyses behind the next Operational Programme design and ex-post evaluation reports to DG REGIO.
